BiblicalUsage: Haphugah is a pause, a letting up, and Jeremiah says there was none. In Lamentations 3:49 his eye trickles down and ceases not, without any intermission, and the grief runs on because the ruin is still in front of him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe some sorrows have no pause built in, and the Bible does not pretend otherwise: the tears keep coming, and God is still there in the middle of them.
